about: Brauns Law Accident Injury Lawyers, PC is a personal injury firm with offices in Duluth, Peachtree Corners and Stone Mountain.

The firm states that the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock. It publishes material in English and Spanish. It does not state a fee model on its public pages, so none is recorded here.

G1.evidence: Georgia does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

G2.source: Published decisions of the Supreme Court of Georgia on the discipline of State Bar of Georgia members, indexed by CourtListener (Free Law Project)
G2.evidence: No attorney this firm names appears as the respondent in any of the 662 published discipline decisions of the Supreme Court of Georgia on the discipline of State Bar of Georgia members, 1979 to 2026. Published decisions record what has been decided, so this covers a disbarment or suspension on the record and not whether a registration is current today.

G3.evidence: 3 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. Georgia publishes no business register we can query for free. The Secretary of State sells the bulk corporations file over FTP, $500 for a single extract or $5,000 a year for weekly ones, and its free entity search answers an automated reader with a 403 on every path including its own robots file, which is a bot challenge we do not work around. A register that is for sale is a published record in the sense that matters here only if somebody buys it. This is a limit of the published record and not something the firm can change.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 1 named attorney published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 751 public client reviews across 3 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2007-05-12, so it has been operating for more than a year
